basic_details.job_title: University of Calicut Speech Language Pathologist & Audiologist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Three posts of Speech Language Pathologist & Audiologist (on contractual basis) are open under the Community Based Disability Management and Rehabilitation Programme (CDMRP) of the Department of Psychology, University of Calicut. Applications on plain paper must reach the Director- CDMRP, Department of Psychology, Calicut University-PO, Pin-673635 on or before 6 December 2026 (4 pm). The consolidated pay is Rs. 26,400/- per month.

content_sections.heading: About Calicut University CDMRP
content_sections.text: The Community Based Disability Management and Rehabilitation Programme (CDMRP) is a joint project of the Department of Psychology, University of Calicut and the Social Justice Department, Govt. of Kerala. The vacancy notification dated 24.11.2026 was issued by the Director, CDMRP, Department of Psychology, University of Calicut.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: There is no prescribed application form. Write the application on plain paper giving your full bio-data, and send it with the enclosures listed below to this address: Director- CDMRP, Department of Psychology, Calicut University-PO, Pin-673635 All applications should reach this address on or before 6 December 2026 (4 pm). The notice does not mention a particular postal mode or any text to be written on the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: All three vacancies are for one post, Speech Language Pathologist & Audiologist, split between two CDMRP units: Essential qualification: Bachelor of Audiology and Speech Language Pathology (BASLP). Registration: Valid RCI certificate. Desirable qualification: Master in Audiology and Speech Language Pathology (MASLP). Mode of appointment: Contract. Consolidated pay: Rs. 26,400/- P.M. The notice does not mention any experience requirement, age limit or allowances in addition to the consolidated pay. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Full bio-data written on plain paper Passport size attested photograph Attested copies of mark sheets Attested copies of certificates Other necessary documents

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: All applications will be processed by the Director – CDMRP. The shortlisted candidates will be called for interview before the selection committee. The notice does not give the interview date or the criteria for shortlisting.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Calicut University Recruitment 2026 for Speech Language Pathologist & Audiologist?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 at the CDMRP Calicut University Unit and 2 at the CDMRP Kannur Unit.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Director- CDMRP on or before 6 December 2026 (4 pm).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Speech Language Pathologist & Audiologist post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a Bachelor of Audiology and Speech Language Pathology (BASLP) with a valid RCI certificate; a Master in Audiology and Speech Language Pathology (MASLP) is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this post?
faq.answer: The post carries a consolidated pay of Rs. 26,400/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send an application on plain paper with full bio-data, a passport size attested photograph and attested copies of mark sheets, certificates and other necessary documents to Director- CDMRP, Department of Psychology, Calicut University-PO, Pin-673635.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The Director – CDMRP will process all applications, and shortlisted candidates will be called for interview before the selection committee.

faq.question: Q7. Is the Speech Language Pathologist & Audiologist job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the mode of appointment is contract.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be posted at the CDMRP Calicut University Unit (1 vacancy) or the CDMRP Kannur Unit (2 vacancies).
